name: By My Side
source:
Ash Lee just wants to survive high school. The thoughts of the future after graduation scare him. His parents never understand him. His crush doesn’t even try to get to know him.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
艾什·李只想平平安安熬过高中生涯。一想到毕业后的未来他就害怕不已，父母从来不理解他，暗恋对象甚至连了解他的意愿都没有。

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
